infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The app uses the camera so you can snap evidence for a report. Do not put yourself in danger to take a photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: The app attaches photos you choose to a tip you can read to 911 or the hotline.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: The app can attach your current location to a tip so responders know where you are.
